reply_text:
@Gideon Sato: you first reported the kiosks offline at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug** in this channel. Your message said both inbound lanes were showing a white screen after badge scan, and that the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard.

That clipboard is the only description of the guard's activity in the channel. Mateo's 11:03 AM post says kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836, so the guard was logging trailers by hand until the kiosks came back. This channel doesn't show anything about the guard between 10:42 and 11:03 beyond that. I can only see this channel, so if there were earlier reports by phone or in other places, they aren't in what I can read.
